ledger.quote: Accordingly, we maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.

ledger.promise: FY26 NWC/sales around 12%, later tightened to around 10%

ledger.actual: FY26 NWC/sales is not reported. Cash conversion cycle improved from -101 to -151 days and CFO rose from 9,151 to 16,741, which points the right way.

ledger.actual: Moved to Q1 FY27 on the Q4 FY26 call, then to 30 Sep 2026 on the Q1 FY27 call. Nothing in these materials confirms closing.

ledger.promise: Hydrocarbon margins recover and legacy loss-making projects exit within 2-3 quarters

ledger.promise: FY26 ROE of 18% under the Lakshya plan

ledger.actual: FY26 ROE is not reported. It was 17.6% excluding one-offs at Q3. The Lakshya 31 ROE target was set lower, at 16-17%.

ledger.promise: Additional 18 MW of data centre capacity commissioned by end FY26
ledger.quote: another 18 megawatts will get commissioned by the end of this fiscal year.
ledger.actual: No later call in these materials confirms commissioning.

credibility.label: low
credibility.summary: Both FY26 headline targets were missed: revenue grew 11.8% against 15%, and PPM margin was 7.8% against 8.5%. Both had been reaffirmed as late as the January 2026 call, when 9M revenue growth was only 12% and Q4 needed about 22% growth. The Hyderabad Metro exit slipped twice and the Kuwait funding fell through; only the FY27 revenue guide is so far tracking (H1 +11.4%).

narrative_vs_numbers.story: In January 2026 management said it was 'reasonably confident' of 15% FY26 revenue growth on a customary Q4 ramp-up.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: 9M FY26 revenue 203,113 vs 181,342, up 12.0%. Reaching 15% (294,094) needed Q4 of about 90,981, up 22.3%. Actual Q4 was 82,762 (+11.3%) and FY26 came in at +11.8%.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: After Q1 FY27 management said it did not expect any margin erosion and was on the trend indicated earlier.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Group EBITDA margin fell to 12.0% in Q1 FY27 (12.6% a year earlier) and 11.2% in Q2 FY27 (12.5%). Q2 EBITDA rose 3.5% while revenue rose 15.8%. PPM margin is not reported separately.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management expected a softer FY27 first half because of supply chain disruption, with a pickup in H2.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q1 FY27 revenue grew only 6.7%, but Q2 grew 15.8%. H1 growth of 11.4% is already inside the 10-12% full-year range.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management said the Q3 FY26 PAT decline of about 4% came from a one-time Labour Codes charge of Rs 11.9 billion (1,190 crore).
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q3 FY26 PAT was 3,825 vs 3,974 (-3.7%), while EBITDA rose 16.4% to 9,190. PBT of 5,370 sat about 1,640 crore further below EBITDA than in Q2, which is consistent with a one-off of that size.

bull.point: FY27 revenue is tracking the guidance despite the flagged soft first half.
bull.evidence: H1 FY27 revenue was 146,692, up 11.4% year on year. Q2 FY27 grew 15.8% to 78,750, a quarterly high outside Q4.

bull.point: Large multi-year offshore order visibility, with margins guided above normal Middle East EPC margins.
bull.evidence: Offshore wind order book of about 57,000-60,000 crore, to be executed over 4-5 years. 6 GW of the 8 GW TenneT job will be fabricated at Kattupalli over 3-4 years.

bull.point: Cash generation and working capital improved in FY26, and the NWC target was tightened.
bull.evidence: CFO rose from 9,151 to 16,741. Cash conversion cycle went from -101 to -151 days. FY26 NWC guidance was cut from 12% to about 10% and held at about 10% for FY27.
bull.source: reported numbers; Q3 FY26 call p9

bear.point: Management missed both headline FY26 targets after reaffirming them one quarter before year end.
bear.evidence: FY26 revenue grew 11.8% against 15%, and PPM margin was 7.8% against 8.5%. Both were reaffirmed on the Jan 2026 call, when 9M growth was 12.0%.
bear.source: Q3 FY26 call p8; Q4 FY26 call p5, p13; reported numbers

bear.point: Operating margin is falling, and profit growth depends on items below EBITDA that these materials do not explain.
bear.evidence: Group EBITDA margin was 11.6% in H1 FY27 vs 12.6% a year earlier. In Q2 FY27 EBITDA rose 3.5% while PBT rose 20.6% and PAT 27.2%. FY26 EBITDA grew 5.2% on 11.8% revenue growth.

bear.point: Heavy new-business capex comes with a lower ROE ambition and rising debt.
bear.evidence: Lakshya 31 outlays total about 38,000 crore (Green Hydrogen 15,000, Data Centre 10,000 and others). The ROE target fell to 16-17% from 18%. Borrowings rose to 140,300 in FY27 from 125,497 in FY26 (+11.8%).
bear.source: Q4 FY26 call p12, p13, p21; reported numbers
